access_evidence: PROBES.json reg_anvisa_001 records the unbounded GET exceeding our 6 MB cap (TOO_LARGE) — the file is large. The bounded path succeeded: DATASETS/regulatory/brazil_anvisa/raw/TA_CONSULTA_PRODUTOS_SAUDE.csv.head256k is an HTTP 206 Range response, 262,144 bytes, parsed into 902 rows; the directory index /dados/CONSULTAS/PRODUTOS/ (HTTP 200, 5,539 bytes) lists 12 TA_CONSULTA_*.CSV files.
blockers: Server caps HTTP Range responses at 256 KiB, so only a 256 KiB prefix (902 rows) was sampled; the full file is outside budget.
historical_depth: One current-state consultation table per product category (medical devices, IVD, medicines, cosmetics...). Row-level dates present: DT_INICIO_VIGENCIA, DT_VENCIMENTO_REGISTRO, DT_CARGA_ETL (ETL load stamp). No version history.
licence_note: ANVISA presents the files on its 'dados abertos' portal with no login and no key, and the directory index carries no licence statement. Recorded as open_no_explicit_licence rather than inventing a CC-BY grant.
machine_interface: Bulk CSV over HTTP (h5ai directory index). No REST API.
name: ANVISA open data — health product consultation (Produtos para Saúde)
notes: DT_CARGA_ETL is an ETL load timestamp, NOT a publication date; it is not used as source_public_at.
operator: Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA), Brazil
rate_policy: No stated quota. One prefix request; no throttling observed.
robots_summary: HTTP 404 — no robots policy is served.
what_is_new: The one non-US/non-Canadian jurisdiction that yielded genuine keyless records: Brazilian device registrations with an official ANVISA registro number, risk class (SG_RISCO_PRODUTO) and registration validity dates.
